method: One aggregate GIS request per site, then pure analysis and normalization; coordinates previously observed from named providers. QA place identifiers are not real Google IDs.

parcel.method: A unique fee parcel containing the selected point and matching its normalized street address can be suggested automatically. Other candidates require manual selection. No parcel association is engineer verified.

results.candidateMode: Manual candidate for QA; not verified

parcelArea.label: Parcel area
parcelArea.method: Assessor LOT_SIZE (Acres); reported lot area, units converted
notes: Assessor reported lot area can differ from mapped polygon area.

mappedParcelArea.label: Mapped parcel polygon area
mappedParcelArea.method: WGS84 geometry projected with Proj4 to site-local azimuthal equidistant coordinates in meters. Planar polygon area subtracts holes. Approximate public mapping; no survey precision implied.

totalRoofprintArea.label: Total contained roofprint area
totalRoofprintArea.method: Sum of source AREA_SQ_FT (or documented projected fallback) for retrieved contained roofprints only. Boundary-crossing and outside features excluded.
notes: 1 contained returned features. Source areas may overlap; this is a sum, not roofprint union coverage.

containedRoofprintUnion.label: Contained mapped roofprint area (union)
containedRoofprintUnion.method: WGS84 geometry projected with Proj4 to site-local azimuthal equidistant coordinates in meters. Planar polygon area subtracts holes. Approximate public mapping; no survey precision implied. Union of contained roofprint geometries; overlaps counted once. Crossing roofprints are excluded.
notes: Distinct from the sum of source-reported individual areas and parcel-clipped coverage of crossing structures.

mappedRoofprintCoverage.label: Mapped roofprint coverage inside parcel
mappedRoofprintCoverage.method: WGS84 geometry projected with Proj4 to site-local azimuthal equidistant coordinates in meters. Planar polygon area subtracts holes. Approximate public mapping; no survey precision implied. Projected polygon intersection and union; boundary-crossing portions clipped to parcel.
notes: Parcel geometry minus union of all intersecting mapped roofprints clipped to the parcel, including crossing portions. Overlapping roofprints are counted once.
Includes unassessed roads, paving, landscaping and other constraints. Does not establish available BESS installation space.

remainingLandArea.label: Approximate land not covered by mapped roofprints
remainingLandArea.method: WGS84 geometry projected with Proj4 to site-local azimuthal equidistant coordinates in meters. Planar polygon area subtracts holes. Approximate public mapping; no survey precision implied. Area of parcel polygon minus union of parcel-clipped roofprints. Uses mapped geometry area, not assessor lot size.
notes: Parcel geometry minus union of all intersecting mapped roofprints clipped to the parcel, including crossing portions. Overlapping roofprints are counted once.
Includes unassessed roads, paving, landscaping and other constraints. Does not establish available BESS installation space.

roadProximity.label: Parcel to nearest returned mapped road centerline
roadProximity.method: Minimum projected 2D distance from the selected parcel polygon to each returned road centerline. Returns zero if a road intersects or lies inside the parcel. Search is bounded; this is not a route distance.
notes: Proximity does not establish legal, truck, construction or emergency access.

results.partialOutage: Passed: missing roads do not erase parcel/building calculations
